title: Four people injured after drive-by shooting outside boxing event south of Brisbane
summary:
Offenders still at large after shots fired from vehicle outside licensed premises in Loganholme

  • Get our breaking…

blocks.text: Four people have been injured after a drive-by shooting outside a venue hosting a boxing event.
Police said they responded to reports of shots being fired from a vehicle outside a licensed premises in Loganholme, south of Brisbane, at 8.15pm.
“The involved vehicle was witnessed leaving the scene,” police said.
Fitzys Loganholme on Bryants Road was scheduled to host the Logan City Titles Fight Night on Saturday.
Four injured people were taken to hospital, police said, and their condition was being assessed.
The offenders are still at large but police said they did not believe there was an ongoing threat to the public.
Police were urging anyone with information about the incident to contact them.
